placements.note: Test run 2010 and production run 2019 in Hall A.
placements.quote: The A’ Experiment (APEX) in Hall A of Jefferson Lab is a search for a new vector gauge boson

summary.plain: The two Hall A high-resolution spectrometers set to their smallest opening angle, with septum magnets steering electrons and positrons from a thin heavy target into them.
summary.technical: Hall A High Resolution Spectrometers configured at minimum opening angle with septum magnets directing the outgoing e+ and e- into the two arms; gas Cherenkov detectors and timing separate electrons from pions; thin tantalum target.

technology.quote: The High Resolution Spectrometers are set-up to record e⁺e⁻ pairs, from which an invariant mass distribution can be obtained.
technology.value: Hall A High Resolution Spectrometers recording e+e- pairs from a thin high-Z target to build an invariant-mass spectrum
